title: Exactly Three Red Balloons
tests: Whether the final illustration satisfies an exact object count, colour constraint, and clear separation.

faults.what: Only two balloons are visible; the requested third balloon is missing.

judge.summary: The square illustration shows two separated red balloons with dangling strings against a pale blue sky, but the required third balloon is missing.

must_haves.item: Exactly three balloons are visible, with no extra balloons in the background.
must_haves.why: There are only two visible balloons.
Both visible balloons are red, but there is no third red balloon.

must_haves.item: The balloon bodies are separated and individually countable.
must_haves.why: The two visible balloon bodies are well separated and easy to count.

must_haves.item: Each balloon has its own visible dangling string.
must_haves.why: Each visible balloon has a separate, clearly visible dangling string.

must_haves.item: The illustration has a pale blue sky background, a square frame, and no text.
must_haves.why: The image is square, has a pale blue background, and contains no visible text.
